records.name: Tsinghua University Chinese Government Scholarship — Master's
records.provider_name: China Scholarship Council and Tsinghua University
records.field_eligibility: Eligible Tsinghua University master's programmes under the Chinese Government Scholarship routes.
records.nationality_eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens who meet the current Chinese Government Scholarship and Tsinghua admission requirements.
records.tuition_coverage: Full Chinese Government Scholarship coverage includes tuition.
records.accommodation_coverage: Free dormitory accommodation or an accommodation subsidy is included.
records.travel_allowance: No travel benefit is claimed because the verified Tsinghua source does not list one.
records.application_method: Follow Tsinghua's current Chinese Government Scholarship instructions and apply through the stated Type A or Type B route.
records.notes: The next application deadline is not represented until Tsinghua publishes it officially.
eligibility_warnings: Chinese-medium programmes have language requirements.
Type B applicants need the required Tsinghua pre-admission materials.

source.title: Tsinghua University Chinese Government Scholarship
source.relevant_excerpt: Full scholarship covers tuition, accommodation or subsidy, monthly stipend and comprehensive medical insurance.

records.name: Bolashak International Scholarship — Master's
records.field_eligibility: Priority specialities and leading foreign universities named in the current Bolashak rules.
records.nationality_eligibility: Kazakh citizens who meet the current Bolashak eligibility rules.
records.tuition_coverage: The programme's current rules and financing information must be verified for the selected university and route.
records.accommodation_coverage: Bolashak funding information includes a monthly stipend for accommodation, meals and educational literature.
records.travel_allowance: Official Bolashak announcements list air travel support.
records.health_insurance: Official Bolashak announcements list medical insurance.
required_documents: Evidence of work activity where required
records.application_method: Apply through the official Kazakhstan e-government or Bolashak process for the announced selection stream.
records.notes: This is a Kazakhstan-government scholarship for Kazakh citizens to study abroad, not a scholarship for all international applicants to study in Kazakhstan.
eligibility_warnings: Citizenship and return-service obligations apply.
Exact current funding and selection-stream conditions must be checked before applying.

source.title: Bolashak applicant requirements
source.relevant_excerpt: The official rules list master's admission evidence, identity, academic records, medical certificate and motivation letter.

additional_sources.title: Bolashak funding announcement
additional_sources.relevant_excerpt: Bolashak covers accommodation, meals, medical insurance, air travel, visa fees and educational materials.

records.name: IsDB Scholarship Programme for Muslim Communities — Bachelor's
records.field_eligibility: Undergraduate study under the IsDB Scholarship Programme for Muslim Communities in Non-Member Countries.
records.nationality_eligibility: Eligible Muslim communities in non-member countries, subject to the current IsDB programme rules.
records.tuition_coverage: Approved tuition fees are paid directly to universities.
records.accommodation_coverage: A monthly stipend is provided according to the cost of living in the study country.
records.travel_allowance: Students selected to study abroad receive return economy tickets and an installation allowance.
records.health_insurance: Medical treatment at the university or a local government hospital is included.
required_documents: Documents required by the current programme guide
records.application_method: Apply through the official IsDB scholarship process when the programme call is open.
records.notes: The official handbook sets benefits and exclusions; the next deadline is not stated in this evidence.
eligibility_warnings: Visa and residence-permit costs are excluded by the handbook.
Check the current eligibility list and call before applying.

source.title: IsDB SPMC handbook
source.relevant_excerpt: Benefits include tuition, monthly stipend, medical treatment, and return economy tickets for students studying abroad.

records.name: Kazakhstan Government Scholarship Programme — Bachelor's
records.field_eligibility: Bachelor's programmes at selected Kazakhstan universities.
records.nationality_eligibility: Foreign citizens, including persons of Kazakh nationality who are not citizens of Kazakhstan.
records.tuition_coverage: The full cost of tuition fees is covered.
records.health_insurance: Visa and medical-insurance expenses are explicitly excluded.
records.application_method: Register through the linked Kazakhstan scholarship portal, select a university and programme, then complete testing and interview steps.
records.notes: Included because it is the official Kazakhstan government scholarship for foreign citizens; it is deliberately labelled partial because the official page excludes travel, accommodation, visa and insurance.
eligibility_warnings: This is not a fully funded award.
Check the current portal for call dates and eligible universities.

source.title: Scholarship Programme of the Republic of Kazakhstan
source.relevant_excerpt: The scholarship covers full tuition and a monthly allowance, but excludes travel, accommodation, visa and medical insurance.
